questions.question: A conservative force is one for which the work done between two points:
options: Is independent of the path taken
Depends on the speed of the object

questions.question: Which force is conservative?
Mechanical energy is defined as:
options: The sum of kinetic and gravitational potential energy

questions.question: A ball is dropped from 10 m with air resistance ignored. Its speed on landing is:

subtopics.title: The Equation W n c Equals Delta E k Plus Delta E p

questions.question: The work done by non-conservative forces on an object equals:
options: The change in kinetic energy plus the change in potential energy
The change in kinetic energy only

questions.question: If Wnc = 0 for a moving object, then:
options: The object must be at rest

questions.question: A 30 kg child slides from rest down a 3 m slide, arriving at 6 m·s⁻¹. The work done by friction is:
A negative value of Wnc tells you that:
options: Mechanical energy was drained, usually by friction, and became heat

subtopics.title: Working the Equation on Slopes and Rough Ground

questions.question: A 2 kg box slides from rest down a 4 m ramp of height 2,5 m, arriving at 5 m·s⁻¹. Wnc is:
To convert friction's work of −24 J into a force, you divide by:
options: The 4 m length of the ramp, since friction acts along the path
The 2,5 m height, since energy depends on height

questions.question: Dragging the same box back UP the ramp at constant speed, the motor's work must equal:
options: The gain in potential energy minus friction's work
Zero, since the speed is constant
The gain in kinetic energy only
The gain in potential energy plus the energy drained by friction

questions.question: A ball thrown upward returns to the hand moving slower than it left because:
options: Gravity took more energy on the way up than it repaid
Air resistance did negative work on both the way up and the way down
Its mass decreased during the flight
Potential energy was destroyed at the top

subtopics.title: Power — the Rate of Doing Work

questions.question: Power is defined as:
options: The total work done on an object
The rate at which work is done
The energy stored in a system

questions.question: A 60 kg learner runs up stairs 3 m high in 5 s. The learner's power output is about:
A pump raises 120 kg of water per minute from a 30 m borehole. Its minimum power is:
For a truck at a constant 25 m·s⁻¹ against 1 800 N of total resistance, the power delivered is:
In the analogy, gravity is an "honest banker" because it:
options: Repays in full, by any route, whatever it charged for the climb
Charges per metre of path travelled
Keeps a small commission on every trade

questions.question: Friction is a "toll collector" because it:
options: Charges per metre, keeps the energy, and turns it into heat

questions.question: A real skateboarder in a pool rises a little less on each swing because:
options: Her potential energy is converted to mass
Friction removes some mechanical energy on every pass
Kinetic energy cannot be reconverted to height

questions.question: The child entered the slide with 882 J and arrived with 540 J of kinetic energy. The "receipt" of −342 J measures:
options: The energy friction converted to heat

questions.question: A POSITIVE Wnc means:
options: Something — an engine or a push — fed energy into the system
Friction acted over a long path

questions.question: Friction's toll is calculated per metre of path, while gravity's charge depends on:
Arriving at the bottom of a slide slower than the frictionless prediction proves that:
options: The slide was steeper than expected
Non-conservative forces removed mechanical energy on the way down

questions.question: Thabo sprints up the stairs in 3 s; Sipho strolls up in 30 s with an identical box. Compared with Sipho, Thabo does:
options: The same work but ten times the power
The same work and the same power

questions.question: One watt is:
options: One joule of energy delivered per second

questions.question: The formula P = Fv applies when an object:
options: Moves at constant speed against a resisting force

questions.question: A borehole pump's MINIMUM power covers:
options: The kinetic energy of the spinning motor
All electrical losses in the cables
Gravity's bill alone — mass per second times g times the depth
